name: Stich + Vault
tagline: Stitches phone clips into one MP4 and fetches media from your Epic Vault locker
description: Two tools in one desk. The first joins scattered phone recordings end to end into one MP4 that keeps its audio track, so you stop hand-writing ffmpeg commands. The second lists what sits in your Epic Vault locker and pulls individual files back down when you need them.
author: Sm0ken42O
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
